data.narrative:
Fossa Systems is a Series A-stage space and aerospace company that has raised €6.3M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers (Cowboy Space Corporation, Aalyria, Starcloud) and 5 public Space & Aerospace benchmarks (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL), alongside typical venture progression patterns.

Two triangulation methods produce actionable results. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the €6.3M total raised, implying a €13M valuation. Peer-median analysis across the 3-company private comparable set yields a €1.3B median valuation, with a range of €1.1B to €2.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of disclosed revenue figures for the target. The wide gap between stage-progression and peer-median reflects fundamental uncertainty around Fossa's market position relative to later-stage peers.

The triangulated range is €11M (low) to €1.5B (high), with a median of €656M. The stage-progression method anchors the floor; the peer set anchors the ceiling. Key uncertainties include revenue traction relative to Series B-funded peers, customer concentration, and the timing and terms of the next funding round. This range suggests material upside from current capital deployed, contingent on execution against comparable trajectories.
